_ordering_rationale: FDS = FactSet, abonnement data terminals. ASV existant gardé. KPIs additionnels: clients, professionnels, retention (drivers operationnels recurring), Organic ASV (croissance hors M&A).

kpis_supplementary.signal: Croissance hors M&A et FX, vraie traction client. +5.7% FY25 vs +5% ASV total.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: ASV excluant acquisitions/dispositions des 12 derniers mois et effets FX. Mesure la traction organique du carnet d'abonnements FactSet. Reporting reorganisé en FY25 (hors professional services).
kpis_supplementary.description_en: ASV excluding acquisitions/dispositions completed within last 12 months and FX. Tracks organic FactSet subscription book traction. Reporting reorganized in FY25 (excludes professional services).

kpis_supplementary.signal: Croissance soutenue ~9.5%/an, expansion corporate + wealth + PE/VC. Base client diversifiée.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Nombre de clients avec ASV >= $10,000. Croissance via corporate users, wealth management, private equity/VC. Multi-asset class data buyers.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Number of clients with ASV >= $10,000. Growth from corporate users, wealth management, private equity/VC. Multi-asset class data buyers.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Base utilisateurs en hausse rapide, principalement wealth management. Levier croissance ASV par seat.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Nombre total de professionnels utilisant FactSet : asset managers, banquiers, wealth managers, hedge funds, corporates, PE/VC. Driver ASV par seat. Croissance principalement wealth FY25.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Total professionals using FactSet: asset managers, bankers, wealth managers, hedge funds, corporates, PE/VC. ASV-per-seat driver. FY25 growth primarily wealth management.

kpis_supplementary.signal: Retention par client à 91% FY25 vs 90% FY24. Premiere amélioration multi-annuelle.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Retention annuelle exprimée en % de clients. Mesure la fidélisation par compte (différent de retention ASV qui reste >95%). Première progression depuis plusieurs années.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Annual retention expressed as % of clients. Account-level stickiness (differs from ASV retention which stays >95%). First multi-year improvement.

kpis_supplementary.signal: ASV retention >95% sur 5 ans : structure recurring rock-solid type Bloomberg.
kpis_supplementary.description_fr: Retention annuelle exprimée en % d'ASV (poids des contrats). >95% en continu sur 5 ans, indicateur clé du modèle subscription rock-solid.
kpis_supplementary.description_en: Annual retention as % of ASV (revenue-weighted). >95% consistently over 5 years, key indicator of rock-solid subscription model.

_extraction_method: 10-K filings cat1-us, recherche textuelle puis verification numerique. Aucune valeur inventée. 5 sources 10-K croisées.
